DataUse.title: Data use & privacy
DataUse.subtitle: How PersonBrief collects, stores and deletes research.
DataUse.whatBody: PersonBrief helps you prepare for professional meetings by summarising a person's documented professional background from public sources. It is research assistance, not a background check: it never scores personality, trustworthiness, creditworthiness or hiring suitability, and missing information is not a negative finding.
DataUse.sourcesBody: Public web pages found through a search provider, read through that provider where permitted. Pages behind a login (for example LinkedIn, Facebook or Instagram profiles) are never accessed; only search listings that link to them are used. People-search and data-broker sites are excluded. No one is contacted to verify anything.
DataUse.excludedBody: Home addresses, private or leaked contact details, guessed email addresses, friend lists, family relationships, and sensitive traits such as health, religion, ethnicity or political views.
DataUse.storageBody: For each snapshot: source URLs and titles, short supporting excerpts, structured claims with their evidence, contacts and accounts with their publication context, and provider usage. Retrieved page text is kept only for {days} days to allow retries, then removed. Notes and tags are private and stored separately from researched facts.
DataUse.providersBody: Live research sends search queries to Tavily and retrieved text to Anthropic for analysis, under those providers' terms. Demo mode uses only built-in fictional data and makes no external calls.
DataUse.deletionBody: Deleting a profile permanently removes its snapshots, sources, private notes, tags, export and issue records, the research runs that produced it, their retrieved content and related cache entries. Exports are generated on demand and not stored on the server. Demo visitor workspaces are deleted automatically after {hours} hours.
DataUse.correctionsBody: Use “Report an issue” on any profile to flag something incorrect, outdated or about the wrong person. Reports are stored with the profile so you can review them before relying on the brief.
DataUse.limitsBody: Web coverage is never exhaustive, sources can be wrong or outdated, and an official source is not independent verification. Always confirm important details directly. PersonBrief makes no claim of regulatory certification.
